targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 120) SECOND) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'],' ',Attributes['device'],' ',dev.model_name) AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_temperature' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['interface'] IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['serial_number'] IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['model_name'] IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) GROUP BY inst, device)

SELECT interface, count() AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY inst, device) GROUP BY interface

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 120) SECOND) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'],' ',Attributes['device'],' ',dev.model_name) AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_media_errors' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series HAVING avg(Value) > 0 ORDER BY time

SELECT countIf(v=0) AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_smart_status' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY inst, device)

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 120) SECOND) AS time, concat('Critical Warnings ',Attributes['device']) AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_critical_warning' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series HAVING avg(Value) > 0 ORDER BY time
SELECT uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, dev.model_name AS model_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS power_on_seconds FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_power_on_seconds' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, model_name

SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, dev.model_name AS model_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS power_cycles FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_power_cycle_count' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, model_name

SELECT instance, device, model_name, serial_number, max(v) AS total_written FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, dev.model_name AS model_name, dev.serial_number AS serial_number, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_bytes_written' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, model_name, serial_number UNION ALL SELECT a.instance AS instance, a.device AS device, a.model_name AS model_name, a.serial_number AS serial_number, a.v * b.v AS v FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, dev.model_name AS model_name, dev.serial_number AS serial_number, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_attribute' AND Attributes['attribute_name']='Total_LBAs_Written' AND Attributes['attribute_value_type']='raw' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, model_name, serial_number) a INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_block_size' AND Attributes['blocks_type']='physical' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device) b ON a.instance=b.instance AND a.device=b.device) GROUP BY instance, device, model_name, serial_number

SELECT concat(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'],':',Attributes['device']) AS device, 100 - argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_attribute' AND Attributes['attribute_name']='Wear_Leveling_Count' AND Attributes['attribute_value_type']='value' AND dev.interface='sat' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY device ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT concat(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'],':',Attributes['device']) AS device, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS inst, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Attributes['interface'], TimeUnix) AS interface, argMax(Attributes['serial_number'], TimeUnix) AS serial_number, argMax(Attributes['model_name'], TimeUnix) AS model_name, argMax(Attributes['model_family'], TimeUnix) AS model_family FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY inst, device) dev ON ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']=dev.inst AND Attributes['device']=dev.device WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_percentage_used' AND dev.interface='nvme' AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] IN (${node:singlequote}), $node) AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['device'] IN (${disk:singlequote}), $disk) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.interface IN (${type:singlequote}), $type) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.serial_number IN (${serial_number:singlequote}), $serial_number) AND $__conditionalAll(dev.model_name IN (${device_model:singlequote}), $device_model) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY device ORDER BY value DESC
